in_marathi.name: Moksh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Release from bondage
in_marathi.long_meaning: Moksh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Moksh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Moksha', meaning 'release from bondage' or 'liberation'. In Hindu mythology, Moksh is the ultimate goal of every human being, the state of spiritual enlightenment where one is free from the cycle of birth and death.

In Hindu mythology, Moksh is the ultimate goal of every human being, the state of spiritual enlightenment where one is free from the cycle of birth and death.
